rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for dying by drowning or causing a person or animal to drown.

example.english: If I swim over there, I'll drown.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 heoi3 go2 dou6 wui5 zam3 sei2

rows.note: Use this for being submerged or inundated by water or, more figuratively, by a mass of things; it is less conversational than the other choice.

example.english: Floodwaters could drown coastal villages, forcing residents to evacuate.
example.traditional: 洪水淹沒沿岸村落，居民被迫撤離。
example.jyutping: hung4 seoi2 jim1 mut6 jyun4 ngon6 cyun1 lok6 geoi1 man4 bei6 bik1 cit3 lei4

rows.traditional: A 多到 B 處理唔切
rows.jyutping: A do1 dou3 B cyu5 lei5 m4 cit3
rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when information, work, or other things become too numerous for someone to handle.

example.english: Alex has so many files to handle that they could drown him.
example.traditional: 文件多到阿明處理唔切。
example.jyutping: man4 gin6 do1 dou3 aa3 ming4 cyu5 lei5 m4 cit3
